summary: Milestone 2026.06.396's milestone-scoped timing detector reported experiments_completed=0, compute_bound_experiments_count=0, total_wall_time_minutes=0 — the recurring false-zero detector gap, NOT an idle milestone (on-disk ops/changelog.md shows the milestone ran). Per the anti-hallucination guard the locked numeric fields stay at the detector's honest-zero. With 0 compute-bound tasks in the detector's window, both RTX 3090s reading 0% (gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks=null) is correct idle behaviour, not a bottleneck.
bottlenecks_identified: Observability, not execution: the milestone-scoped timing detector again attributed 0 experiments / 0 wall-minutes to this milestone — the recurring false-zero gap. The retro's authoritative timing numbers are therefore zero, so no per-experiment slow-task or GPU-efficiency analysis is possible from the timing block.
The operational-retro trigger is not gated on experiments_completed >= 1, so a full retro turn is spent producing a zero-signal artifact whenever the detector mis-attributes the commit window.
improvements_suggested: Repair the milestone-scoped timing detector's commit attribution (activation-SHA boundary / commit window) so the retro sees real per-experiment durations instead of a false zero.
Add an on-disk results/*.json mtime fallback plus a detector_gap_suspected tripwire so the retro cross-checks the detector's zero against actual artifacts before reporting.
Gate the operational-retro trigger on experiments_completed >= 1 (or emit a one-line detector-gap / empty-window no-op) so a full retro turn is not spent on a zero-signal window.
Engage the idle dual-GPU capacity (both 3090s at 0%/24GB free) with the next milestone's compute-bound tasks; capacity is available and is not the constraint this window.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Fix the milestone-scoped timing detector's commit attribution — this single observability bug has produced false-zero retro data across many consecutive milestones and is the only standing operational defect.
Add the on-disk results/ mtime fallback + detector_gap_suspected tripwire so retros self-correct when the detector under-reports.
Gate the retro on experiments_completed >= 1 so zero-signal retro turns are not spent.
meta_reflection: The recurring operational failure is observability, not execution: the milestone-scoped timing detector reports a false zero while the milestone in fact runs its experiments. The highest-leverage fix is to repair commit attribution (plus an on-disk mtime fallback and retro gating) so retrospectives measure real durations rather than spending a turn on a zero-signal artifact.
